content: To improve performance in low resource domains, we explore three directions. First, we explore domain transfer for abstractive summarization. While domain transfer is not new, compared to prior summarization studies BIBREF6, BIBREF7, our training (news) and tuning (student reflection) domains are quite dissimilar, and the in-domain data is small. Second, we propose a template-based synthesis method to create synthesized summaries, then explore the effect of enriching training data for abstractive summarization using the proposed model compared to a synthesis baseline. Lastly, we combine both directions. Evaluations of neural abstractive summarization method across four student reflection corpora show the utility of all three methods.
